purpose: Advisory research planning inventory; not a queue, permission, availability assertion, or capability registry. Status is a dated planning assessment, not live GitHub state.

campaigns.evidence: Integrated as #191: the deterministic executor, private campaign leases and the read-only observation projection are on main. Live model gates remain unexercised and operator-controlled; their integration is not a live qualification.
campaigns.acceptance: Independent exact-head review, combined tests and custody corrections; preserve manual gates.

campaigns.evidence: Integrated as #206: campaign-owned environment provisioning and preflight now prove the parent and an isolated child import identity. The convergence-01 environment used it and preflight reported qualified with 11 of 11 checks.
campaigns.acceptance: Two source-distinct checkouts prove parent and isolated child import identity; no shared environment mutation.

campaigns.evidence: Integrated as #199: the harness records source and package identity, host sampling and per-test spawn/Git attribution. Its first findings are retained as loaded-host observations, not as a quiet baseline.
campaigns.acceptance: Reconcile shared fixtures and configuration, independent exact-head tests, retain raw measurement distinctions. Coordinate shared fixture/configuration merge order with #191; neither PR is a hard functional prerequisite of the other.

campaigns.evidence: Measured on 2b3113c under two passing quiet gates and published as convergence-baseline-001. It is a characterization baseline: source_first is structurally false, per-iteration CPU means were not sampled, and instrumentation overhead is unquantified, so optimization qualification stays open under #147.
campaigns.acceptance: Accepted as the initial characterization baseline. Optimization qualification requires a matched uninstrumented control, per-iteration CPU sampling, a decision on the source_first gate and an explicitly named tag; none is claimed here.

campaigns.evidence: Git subprocess batching remains a hypothesis. The characterization baseline measures 32,835 Git calls and 2,673.7 s of cumulative Git call duration, which ranks the target but does not show that any wall time is reclaimable.
campaigns.acceptance: Controlled before/after exact test set and semantic equivalence, fewer subprocesses, measured improvement.

campaigns.evidence: Prerequisites #191 and #206 are integrated and the operator procedure is published. The canary is unexecuted: it awaits a reviewed manifest and a separate authorization of one exact plan digest. No attempt has been prepared or submitted.
campaigns.acceptance: One reviewed hash-files task, independent expected digest, explicit authorization, one attempt and sanitized returned receipt.

campaigns.evidence: PR #187 is integrated; PR #193 remains intentionally parked, so the queue-counter and Corkboard instrumentation is not promoted. Remaining input work waits on that decision and on open issues #10 and #35.
campaigns.acceptance: Exact-head guard review and focused tests; experimental #193 stays draft unless separately approved.
